maddeler.e:
نعتمد (form VIII)
# نَعْتَمِدُ (naʕtamidu) /naʕ.ta.mi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# نُعْتَمَدُ (nuʕtamadu) /nuʕ.ta.ma.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# نَعْتَمِدَ (naʕtamida) /naʕ.ta.mi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# نُعْتَمَدَ (nuʕtamada) /nuʕ.ta.ma.da/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
